assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All three scope boundaries and the three key areas use the repository's provisional rough polygons (inferred from announcement text extents and approximate areas, reviewed 2026-08-07).
assumptions.impact: Area metrics (site_area_sqm, green_ratio, key area areas, land-use areas) are provisional recomputations in EPSG:4548; they must be recalculated after official polygons replace the provisional ones. Provisional geometry is not an official redline.

assumptions.statement: Land-use partition, building footprints, road centerlines, green/public space and phasing are concept designs generated by the AI agent for spatial-structure communication.
assumptions.impact: They are not regulatory conditions, existing-condition surveys, engineering alignments, or parcel-level decisions; professional teams must deepen them with official data.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection extents (e.g., Qinghuayuan Station) are shown as concept markers only; official heritage GIS layers must replace them.
assumptions.impact: No heritage control conclusion is implied; final design must respect official protection scopes and construction-control zones.

assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, density, green ratio and setback are officially missing; this proposal does not fabricate them and marks them pending.
assumptions.impact: Development-intensity metrics stay 'unknown' in metrics.json until official regulatory conditions arrive.

assumptions.statement: All 12 scenario cards, 3 pilgrimage landmarks, event systems and operation mechanisms are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: They imply no approved operation, government arrangement, investment commitment, or engineering feasibility.

assumptions.statement: The provisional polygon PROV-KEY-003 (Dazhongsi AI industry cluster, announced ~72.0 ha) has its centroid near Beijing North Station, about 2.26 km from Dazhongsi station (community-verified, Issue #1029). This proposal keeps the provisional coordinates unchanged, retains the provisional annotation, and limits all Dazhongsi-area design conclusions to directional concepts.
assumptions.impact: Dazhongsi TOD / station-city integration conclusions are directional only; all geometry, metrics and figures must be recalculated once official key-area polygons and station/road anchoring relations arrive.

assumptions.statement: A community cross-check (Issue #846, 2026-08-11) finds that the provisional overall-design polygon PROV-SITE-001 (announced ~11.4 km2) does not intersect the OSM-mapped built section of the Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park (nearest distance ~412.5 m, 0% coverage in EPSG:4548), while the research scope PROV-RESEARCH-001 fully covers it. Both may be imprecise; this proposal keeps the provisional coordinates unchanged and treats all site-level geometry as directional.
assumptions.impact: Site-level spatial anchors, land-use partition and all area metrics remain provisional and must be recalculated once official boundary polygons replace PROV-SITE-001; no conclusion depends on the park polygon's exact location.
